config_keys.coop_objective: False (master switch; False/absent = byte-identical legacy search)
config_keys.coop_solo_cap: 16 (solo rollouts only for top-N candidates by group gain per WM call; None = all, batched into the candidate call)
config_keys.coop_diversity: True (finalists/top-k: top coop_keep_top by score, then greedy max-min descriptor spread among candidates >= pool median score)
config_keys.coop_active_accel: 0.3 m/s^2 (|issued plan - issued policy| above this = active second)
config_keys.coop_novelty: False (k-NN novelty vs verified bank; needs coop_novelty_bank)
config_keys.coop_novelty_bank: None or list of 15-number role descriptors (from the bank-descriptors CLI)
config_keys.coop_novelty_weight: 0.5 (x std of the call's scores, times z-scored k-NN distance)

descriptor: per member [participates, onset_s, early mean, plan mean, mean |dev|] of ISSUED plan command (post feasibility clamp) minus ISSUED policy command (WM policy forecast under the same clamp); z-normalised over the searched pool; bank side: role summary (ramp lane 2 / mainline) of SUMO issued_safe - mappo_safe

gpu_cost_multiplier_estimate.basis: live it2_K2 label-list8 shape (iterations 2, screen_K 2 H300, final_K 8 H<=420, top_k 8, finalists 8), coop_solo_cap 16; action x future (action x future x horizon-s)
gpu_cost_multiplier_estimate.extra_wm_calls_per_search: one capped solo call per screen iteration (2) when population > cap; final solos batched into the K8 call

enable_for_next_batch.what_changes_live: GPU workers must run the commit's mppi_search.py + coop_search.py + ls_gpu.py (+ niche_collect.py validator); cpuQ collector must run niche_collect.py + ls_collection.py. Both need the usual source-bound CPU qualification and rolling drained-boundary GPU handover by the live agent (not done here). Without the config file the new sources behave byte-identically.
enable_for_next_batch.cpuQ_enable: cd <qualified source root>/pytools && python -m tools.coopmwm.coop_search enable <COLLECTION_ROOT> [--lambda 1.0] [--solo-cap 16] [--alternate] [--bank-descriptors BANK_DESC.json]   # writes immutable LS_COOP_SEARCH_CONFIG.json (open 'x'); the collector loads it at supervisor start; new admissions then carry search_config = it2_K2 niches1/4 + coop keys (--alternate: coop on ordinals with (ordinal//2)%2==0, an outcome-blind 2x2 with niche parity)
enable_for_next_batch.bank_descriptors: python -m tools.coopmwm.coop_search bank-descriptors PLANS.json --out BANK_DESC.json   # PLANS.json = list of {plan:{members, issued}, lanes:{vid:lane}, policy_commands} from SUMO branch observable issued_safe / mappo_safe
enable_for_next_batch.gpu: no new GPU CLI: plan_service/mppi_runtime pass record.search_config (validated by niche_collect.validate, binding niche_comparison=True) into mppi_search.search; coop report lands in result.coop_objective, per-finalist result.finalists[i].coop and collection_top8[i].coop; ls_collection copies coop_objective into labels

caveats: Synergy is WM-predicted; solo gains are paired vs 'policy' in the same WM call, the capped screen solos use a second call with the same K/H (CRN futures by index).
Uncapped candidates in a screen call get the median computed synergy (flagged synergy_imputed).
Diversity lowers the mean synergy of the 8 finalists vs synergy-only ranking (it spreads them) but keeps the top-2; set coop_diversity=False to compare.
Coop finalist rule replaces niche-best-first in niches=4 mode when the option is on.
